items.headline: Premier League weekend: Man United host Aston Villa in Sunday's big one
items.body: The Premier League is back in full this weekend, and Sunday's headliner is Manchester United vs Aston Villa at Old Trafford. Saturday's no slouch either — Arsenal host Hull and Nottingham Forest take on Manchester City.
items.say: Big Premier League weekend — United and Aston Villa square off Sunday at Old Trafford. You keeping up with the Premier League this year?

items.headline: Barça head to Atlético Madrid for La Liga's weekend showdown
items.body: Spain's big one this weekend: Barcelona travel to Atlético Madrid at the Metropolitano on Sunday — always a spiky, physical afternoon. Real Madrid are out the same day too, over at Valencia.
items.say: Barcelona play Atlético Madrid in Spain this weekend — those games always get feisty. You follow La Liga at all, or just the big names?

items.headline: Worlds hits the semifinals — Gen.G vs Invictus Gaming today
items.body: The League of Legends knockouts roll on in Allen, Texas: Gen.G — perennial semifinalists still chasing a first crown — meet Invictus Gaming in a best-of-five today, while three-time champs T1 face Bilibili Gaming on Sunday. The grand final lands at Brooklyn's Barclays Center on November 14.
items.say: League of Legends Worlds is down to the final four — Gen.G play today and the whole thing wraps up in Brooklyn next week. You ever dip into any esports?

items.headline: Philly's Sean Brady headlines UFC Fight Night tonight vs Gabriel Bonfim
items.body: A sneaky-good welterweight main event in Vegas tonight: Philadelphia's Sean Brady (19-2) takes on red-hot Brazilian Gabriel Bonfim (20-1) with top-10 stakes, and Tatiana Suarez vs Virna Jandiroba co-headlines. It's on Paramount+.
items.say: There's a solid UFC card tonight — a top-10 welterweight scrap with a Philly guy, Sean Brady, in the main event. You still watch the fights?

items.headline: F1's at wild Interlagos — qualifying today, the Grand Prix Sunday
items.body: The São Paulo Grand Prix weekend is here at Brazil's rollercoaster Interlagos circuit: qualifying is today, the race Sunday. New champ Kimi Antonelli already has the title locked up, so everyone's racing loose — and this track almost always serves up chaos.
items.say: F1's in Brazil this weekend — Interlagos is the track where crazy stuff always seems to happen. You catch any of the races this season?

items.headline: Guillermo del Toro's 'Frankenstein' hits Netflix today
items.body: After a short theatrical run, del Toro's lavish, gothic 'Frankenstein' lands on Netflix today — Oscar Isaac as the obsessed doctor and Jacob Elordi as his heartbreaking creature. It's exactly the kind of beautiful, melancholy monster movie he does best.
items.say: Guillermo del Toro's Frankenstein just dropped on Netflix — supposed to be gorgeous and sad in the best way. You into his stuff, like Pan's Labyrinth or The Shape of Water?

items.headline: Rosalía drops 'LUX' — an orchestral swing sung in 13 languages
items.body: Rosalía's fourth album 'LUX' is out today, and it's a massive artistic leap: full orchestra, operatic vocals, and lyrics across some 13 languages. Lead single 'Berghain' (with Björk and Yves Tumor) set the gloriously dramatic tone.
items.say: Rosalía put out an album today where she sings in like 13 languages over a full orchestra — super ambitious. You heard any of her stuff?

items.headline: Sydney Sweeney goes full boxer in 'Christy' — in theaters today
items.body: Sydney Sweeney transforms into real-life champ Christy Martin in this gritty biopic that drew big reactions at the Toronto festival. It's a brutal, inspiring story both in and out of the ring — a serious swing for Sweeney.
items.say: Sydney Sweeney totally transformed to play a boxer in that new movie Christy — people at the festivals were really impressed. You seen the trailer?

items.headline: 'Pluribus' — the 'Breaking Bad' creator's new Apple TV mystery premieres today
items.body: Vince Gilligan reunites with Rhea Seehorn for 'Pluribus,' a strange, hooky sci-fi drama about 'the most miserable person on Earth' who somehow has to save the world from happiness. Two episodes drop today on Apple TV, then it's weekly.
items.say: Vince Gilligan — the Breaking Bad guy — has a weird new sci-fi show on Apple TV with Rhea Seehorn. The premise is bonkers. You trust him after Better Call Saul?
